inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, was on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are afraid of. The inconsistencies are no accident—they're using these statements to test reactions, sow confusion, and conceal their real agenda of tightening control while pretending it's about something else. Official lines like this are always a cover for the hidden motives at play.
